title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #14

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How many rak'ahs does Dhuhr have? (1 mark)
   A. Five
   B. Two
   C. Four
   D. Three

2. Which surah contains the first five verses revealed? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Ikhlas
   B. An-Nasr
   C. Al-Fatiha
   D. Al-Alaq

3. Which of these is a mistake about Allah's names? (1 mark)
   A. Learning them
   B. Thinking Allah is like a human being
   C. Using them in dua
   D. Teaching them

4. What is a single verse of the Qur'an called? (1 mark)
   A. An ayah
   B. A surah
   C. A rak'ah
   D. A juz

5. What is "rahmah"? (1 mark)
   A. Pride
   B. Fear
   C. Anger
   D. Mercy

6. How did Khadija support the Prophet? (1 mark)
   A. By harming him
   B. With comfort and her wealth
   C. By ignoring him
   D. By leaving him

7. What is a mughalladha najasa? (1 mark)
   A. A prayer
   B. A medium najasa
   C. A heavy najasa
   D. A light najasa

8. What is the dua for parents? (1 mark)
   A. Subhanallah
   B. Bismillah
   C. Rabbir-hamhuma kama rabbayani saghira
   D. Amin

9. Yahya was the son of (1 mark)
   A. Dawud
   B. Musa
   C. Zakariyya
   D. Ibrahim

10. What must a girl cover during prayer? (1 mark)
   A. The whole body except face and hands
   B. Only the arms
   C. Nothing
   D. Only the head

11. Which is a safe practice around stray dogs? (1 mark)
   A. Tease them
   B. Chase them
   C. Feed them by hand
   D. Do not go near them and tell an adult

12. What should we say before brushing? (1 mark)
   A. Bismillah
   B. Nothing
   C. Goodbye
   D. Amin only

13. What is the extended family? (1 mark)
   A. Only neighbours
   B. Relatives beyond parents and siblings
   C. Only friends
   D. Only parents

14. What is a mutawassitah najasa? (1 mark)
   A. A heavy najasa
   B. A light najasa
   C. A medium najasa
   D. A drink

15. If you are sure you made wudhu and only doubt that it broke, what should you assume? (1 mark)
   A. Your wudhu is broken
   B. You are still in wudhu
   C. You must never pray
   D. You are in ghusl

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Describe how a Grade 4 child can practise honesty, generosity, patience and obedience. (4 marks)

17. Choose one early convert and explain a lesson children can learn from that person. (4 marks)

18. State three evils of begging. (3 marks)

19. Name the first and the last prophet. (2 marks)

20. Name two dressing trends a Muslim should avoid. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Four
   Dhuhr has four.

2. D — Al-Alaq
   Surah 96.

3. B — Thinking Allah is like a human being
   Nothing is like Allah.

4. A — An ayah
   Ayah (plural ayat) means verse; a chapter is a surah.

5. D — Mercy
   Rahmah means mercy.

6. B — With comfort and her wealth
   She supported him fully.

7. C — A heavy najasa
   Mughalladha means heavy.

8. C — Rabbir-hamhuma kama rabbayani saghira
   A dua asking mercy for parents.

9. C — Zakariyya
   Yahya was the son of Zakariyya.

10. A — The whole body except face and hands
   This is the minimum for girls.

11. D — Do not go near them and tell an adult
   Some animals may bite.

12. A — Bismillah
   Bismillah is said before good acts.

13. B — Relatives beyond parents and siblings
   Grandparents, aunts, uncles and cousins.

14. C — A medium najasa
   Mutawassitah means medium.

15. B — You are still in wudhu
   Doubt does not remove certainty.

SECTION B
----
16. (4 marks)
   Answer: Honesty: return lost items; generosity: share lunch; patience: wait calmly for a turn; obedience: come when parents call.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each virtue with a suitable action.

17. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example, Ali teaches that a young person can be brave and truthful for Allah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the person, 1 mark for a fact, 1 mark for a lesson, 1 mark for clear explanation.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Loss of dignity, laziness, wasted resources, lies, harm to children.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: Adam was the first and Muhammad (S.A.W.) was the last.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: Tight or see-through clothes, and clothes with rude words or pictures.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
